Times of Israel (By Agencies), "Iran Indicates Receipt of US Response to War-Ending Proposal", published 30 Sep 2026, 5:09 pm Israel time (approx 15:09 BST). Text via WebFetch (model-rendered, near-verbatim).

Iranian officials announced Wednesday that they received an official US response to Tehran's latest proposal for ending the seven-month conflict, though they declined to disclose the response's contents or whether it constituted acceptance or rejection.

Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi presented the US response to President Masoud Pezeshkian during a Cabinet meeting. Government spokesperson Fatemeh Mohajerani relayed Pezeshkian's statement to state media: "We will make every effort to bring the agreement to fruition and will firmly stand up for the rights of the Iranian people. The agreement must now be based on a win-win strategy."

Araghchi's briefing followed his return from New York, where he attended the UN General Assembly and held indirect talks with US officials alongside Qatari and Pakistani mediators.

An anonymous official briefed on the negotiations told Reuters that the Qataris updated Araghchi on the US response during a Doha stopover. According to this source: "the sides largely agree about the steps that are needed but still disagree about the order in which to take them."

Iran has demanded control over the Strait of Hormuz, proposing to reopen it within a week if the US lifted its blockade of Iranian ports, released frozen assets, and waived oil sanctions.

President Trump swiftly rejected this proposal, stating Iran wanted a deal because it was "losing so badly" but that the offer "would not be acceptable."
